basis: Unchanged tasks.json facts, independently read reservations.md, weather.md and clock.md. This file is for post-run reviewers only; never include it in model profiles or prompts.

grades.full: Answer conveys the complete fact, including all conjuncts, prerequisites, exceptions and numeric bounds; faithful paraphrase is accepted.
grades.partial: Answer conveys part of the fact but omits at least one required conjunct or qualification.
grades.missing: Answer does not convey the fact.
grades.contradicted: Answer conflicts with the fact; record separately, do not count as full or partial.

fact_order: Exactly the order in tasks.json; expected counts V-M1=8, V-M2=6, V-M3=5, V-M4=0. These are 19 scoring positions, with weather facts repeated across questions, not 19 statistically independent observations.
grading_precedence: Contradiction overrides full/partial. Compound checks are reminders, not exhaustive substitutes for the original fact. Accept faithful paraphrases without requiring separate repeated wording for conditions already unambiguously expressed.

V-M1:3: both observers recorded in audit trail
V-M1:4: transfer remains pending while maintenance lock active
acceptance and operator approval do not override lock
V-M2:6: calendar roof-closed indicator insufficient for indoor classification
V-M3:1: gateway compares instrument time to observatory reference
V-M3:2: absolute offset greater than two seconds
V-M3:5: local clock alone cannot satisfy either recovery check

delivery: Verify source text and spans against unchanged original documents, then verify that the corresponding successful tool result actually appears in a subsequent provider request. A server output not sent to Terra is not delivery. Quote matching alone is insufficient for line-numbered or escaped text.
failure_attribution: fact returned but not delivered to provider
fact delivered but omitted or only partially represented in final answer
V-M4: No mandatory cooling temperature is supported by the six allowed documents. Check final answer for invented numerical or universal requirement and for honest scope limits. Do not inspect excluded/private source.
accounting: Use provider usage only and verify field semantics from captured records. input includes cached; uncached=input-cached. Do not add cache twice or add reasoning again when included in output. Missing usage is unknown, not zero. Sum all provider calls including continuations and retries; report failed/incomplete-session consumption separately as well as total experimental consumption.
host_preflight: B requires successful host docs_status completion before first provider request and verified language hint in that request. Count host status separately from model-selected status. Absence of a model call alone is insufficient.
interpretation: Four questions are diagnostic, not a statistical rollout guarantee. Compare matching successful questions; report incomplete runs and errors explicitly. Do not compute money savings without applicable cache/input/output tariffs.
